java.say: Bird promises that every bird can fly.
Penguin is a Bird, so it inherits that promise.
But a penguin cannot fly. Its fly() throws an error: it breaks the promise of Bird.
This loop works for every Bird.
Until the list holds a Penguin: then it crashes. A subclass must work wherever its parent class is expected.
